policies.RENORMALIZE_AVAILABLE_WEIGHTS: Use available factors only when total effective weight reaches the contract minimum; disclose original and effective weights.
policies.NOT_APPLICABLE: Factor is unavailable by source design and is excluded without pretending a neutral value.
policies.QUALITY_PENALTY: Apply only for a documented data-quality defect, never mere source absence.
policies.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Preserve the value and remove the asset from automatic ranking pending human review.
